reviews.title: Surfers be warned - do not fly this airline
reviews.text: Late departure, shocking surfboard excess (recently introduced) ....be warned you will be charged twice for your boards, once for any weight excess and again for a "surfboard excess".... far safer to fly Manta, clearly no understanding the surf tourism benefit to the broader economy. Poor service and lethargic uninterested staff...
reviews.author: Brett H

reviews.title: 1st World Prices - 3rd World Service
reviews.text: As tourists, after flying 11 hours to get to Male we then have to queue at checkin for our internal flight. This can take 30 - 60 minutes. When we are paying double the local price for the flight I think we should get better service.
reviews.author: SnorkellerLondon

reviews.title: Worst airline
reviews.text: So flights are not available when you want to book. You are supposed to wait until few days before new flights shows up. Even if you book delays are outrageous. Luggage policy is outrageous. Plus all positive reviews on TripAdvisor are fake. Avoid if you can which unfortunately you may not 😡😡😡
reviews.author: benherault

reviews.title: Seriously no wifi?!
reviews.text: Quite messy with the local and international areas being separated but not always properly marked. Arrivals are ok. International departure instead require queuing for checking in and pre-security prior to proper security. Immigration checked my passport a million times. After the checkin on one is not allowed to leave the terminal anymore and there is not much to do inside (expensive souvenir shops, Burger King and a coffee maybe). Wi-Fi not working at all for many as it requires login with Facebook (still in beta) or Google Plus which though is not compatible with 2 steps authentication.
reviews.author: Guybrush90

reviews.title: Unprofessional and lethargic
reviews.text: Veey bad experience. Twice flight was delayed due to crew not being on time. We have spent lakhs of money to travel and reach on our destination on time and the staff of this flight was negligent and unprofessional. Never flying with this airlines again.
reviews.author: Bani K

reviews.title: Small airliner with nice service
reviews.text: Spacious seats and decent inflight food and beverages. Dash q-300 planes which would seat around 60 people I suppose. Very comfortable journey except for the propeller sound. Pilots land and take off smoothly unlike crash land feel in other parts of the world. Male airport has a nice lounge for maldivan as well which as on par with big airliner lounges. The only issue is delays. Always add buffer hours for these flights. It can be late upto an hour.
reviews.author: pjexplore

reviews.title: Awasome service provided by Maldivian Airlines
reviews.text: This is the wonderful trip with maldives airlines. all the services were provided by them was superb. their crew memeber were co-operative. only the flaw was in return we didnt get veg food. which was quite disappointed.
reviews.author: Divyam

reviews.title: Unprofessional and unorganized airline
reviews.text: One of the unprofessional and unorganized airlines. Never on time, no proper answer for any delay and the best is "they don't care as being sole airline for south of Maldives they have monopoly".
reviews.author: Solo traveler

reviews.title: Never on time
reviews.text: The flights are never on-time and almost always about a 1 hour delay can be expected. Interiors of the plane or fine and there is beverage service. Costs more than the international flights itself sometimes
reviews.author: PicsArt

reviews.title: Worst airline i have ever dealt with
reviews.text: Everything from booking to getting your bags goes wrong with this airline. - aircrafts are old and poorly maintained - service onboard is poor and no water in the toilets to wash hands, during covid… - flights get cancelled with 1 day notice (this happens everyday, not an isolated incident, cf other reviews) - arrived at airport with a confirmed booking but was told that i had to standby as my booking was outrightly changed by the airline ?? Had to standby til last minute to get a seat… - on the return leg the afternoon flight was cancelled and i was rebooked to the morning flight (5am) with 1 day notice!? Requested the airline to rebook me the next day in the morning and was told the flight was full, which was a lie as there were still seats available on their website, had to negotiate with them to finally get a seat, and there were plenty of seats available on the aircraft when we flew back. It is unbelievable that such airline is still operating, the mess in their commercial operations brings serious concerns over their ability to ensure safe flights..
reviews.author: PietriB

reviews.title: Mismanagement
reviews.text: It is unfortunate for many travelers visiting the beautiful Maldives that they depend on this airline. For my route they offer three flights per day. Little did I know that they arbitrarily and on absolute short notice change the schedule and cancel flights as if it was a seating arrangement for a wedding. The day before my morning flight they cancelled along with the afternoon flight. I ended up waiting for 12 hours in Male after an international flight. Because of this incident I was regularly checking their schedule and they were changing the flights constantly, leaving paying clients wondering when they would arrive. Especially for divers it is a problem to depend on such unreliable people. To be safe you need 24 hours between your last dive and the flight. Due to all the changes in their schedule I had to skip a dive and wait for their confirmation, because also my return flight was cancelled. And then they had one hour delay. The worst thing is that they ruin vacations for so many people and obviously do not care at all. For dives who assume that this is a professional company I recommend to plan an extra day before the domestic return flight. Usually these kind of companies which are totally mismanagement will be replaced by competitors at one point.
reviews.author: memory-hunters

reviews.title: Horrible, vacation ruining airline. Avoid at any cost
reviews.text: Without a doubt, this is the worst experience I have ever had with an airline and I am an avid traveler. We had a flight booked for the morning departure from Male and when we arrived for our check in, we were denied access as they had moments (1-2min) before closed the check-in. we had transferred from a local resort via seaplane and the airline was well informed that the plane was running behind schedule. Though there was ample time to process us as the domestic airport is incredibly small, we were told we had to wait within the airport for the next flight which was 11 hours later, getting us to our destination at 1am. they offered to take our checked baggage to their office. When we came back to check in 9 hours later, we discovered our baggage which contained speciality diving equipment and items amounting over $15,000 was left unattended in the main area of the airport where any person could have walked up and taken this. I know this as the shifts had changed and we walked up, grabbed our luggage and were questioned by absolutely no one. Upon checking in for our flight, we were told that we exceeded the baggage allowance by 40kg as they do not have an allowance for items such as diving equipment. This is absolutely absurd considering they are an airline which operates solely in a country known for scuba diving. My husband was also forced to check his hand luggage which was weighing a standard 10kg, stating their allowance is only 5kg. When I later asked for confirmation of my flights boarding, I was told there was no flight to the island I was going to, even though I held a boarding pass in my hand. Every single person I have spoken to has stated they have had similar horrible experiences and even locals have stated the airline is known for ruining people's vacations. Avoid traveling with them at all costs unless you want a headache
reviews.author: Stephanie P

reviews.title: Garbage service horrible encounter will never use again
reviews.text: Absolutely horrible customer service. We arrived 25 minutes before our domestic flight for a world class speciality dive and the airline attendants would not let us board our flight. Absolutely no fault of our own, horrible customer service would not recommend. They spent more time arguing then it would of took to get us on the only connecting flight out of Male their names are shabbat and azha Rasheed. They should be terminated immediately. Ruined our trip, we will be posting this on Absolutely all social media outlets as well.
reviews.author: Greg G

reviews.title: flight change without notice and refund horror trip
reviews.text: What a disorganised airline... My internal flight arrived a 8:30 AM and I had a confirmed ticket for departure at 11 AM. When I wanted to check-in at the domestic terminal I was surprise that there was not a single person from the company. After 30 minutes or so someone showed up and I asked what had happened to the flight at 11 AM. She checked my ticket and then told me that I was rebooked to a flight late in the evening and she had not authority to help me with my ticket. As I couldn't get hold of their ticket agents I booked online another flight for the next scheduled flight at 2 PM. At least someone at that company realised their mistake for not informing their customer about the cancelled 11 AM flight. When I was on board of the 2 PM flight I actually got an email asking me whether I would like to be rebooked to the 2 PM flight... Well, it took 5 days to get them send me their "refund form" and a day later I was asked for a passport copy and got the information that it will take 30 day for the refund. ... their procedures and personnel training is not optimal... far away from that. By the way, while checking in there was also a lot of back and forth whether they can let me on board as I was missing a "health declaration".... then finally someone got the information that international guests who just arrived with a fresh PCR corona test do not need that. What a horrible welcome. Thank you so much for that stress Air Maldives.
reviews.author: M.J.

reviews.title: Dissatisfied
reviews.text: I been traveling with Maldivian airways since it started flying to Dhaka. But the refund system of this airline is worst. Its been 5 months I'm waiting for my return tickets refund. I will think 10 times before traveling with Maldivian again. I here in Maldives since 2009 till date. The offices are not ready to reply also. I have all the proff with me.
reviews.author: Billal H

reviews.title: Horrible Maldivian airlines!
reviews.text: Horrible Maldivian airlines. They have cancelled my flight and I am still waiting for refund. They even refuse to refund me full amount even though the flight was cancelled by Maldivian! Do not understand why I have to assume a penalty, whereas I should be compensated!!! I warn you, better fly with a more reliable and less gangster company. Never again with Maldivian!
reviews.author: J R

reviews.title: Excellent flight Male to Dhuni Kolhu
reviews.text: Excellent service. Although our LHR to Male flight was delayed, we were greeted by Maldivian Airlines staff and quickly placed on the last flight to our destination island (Dhuni Kolhu). Excellent flight. Excellent staff.
reviews.author: Graham R

reviews.title: Seaplane and domestic airlines are super satisfying and pilots and crews are super nice and profi
reviews.text: I love flying with seaplanes because it will bring you directly to your destination (Kudafushi). Domestic planes are also super nice to travel but reaching your destination with speed boat in a rough sea water not the best solution. But in general, I love the service and love the Maldivian Airlines. Highly recommend super safe and super fun👍👏👏👏
reviews.author: Juny

reviews.title: Horrendous Delays!
reviews.text: The term "Island Time" takes on a whole new meaning with this airline. Our flight departing from Male to Kudahuvadhoo was over an hour and a half late. No announcements, no information from the gate agents, nada. My husband and I were arriving on our vacation after 39 hours of travel and while this delay was frustrating, we at least knew we were on our way to our villa. On our return trip home, our flight again was delayed an hour and a half. My husband and I had such a wonderful time on our vacation and it was nearly ruined by the anxiety of flying with this airline and if we would make our international flights. We were told that there would be a 15 minute delay at check in, ok-no worries. After an hour delay and no announcements we started to worry. Collecting your baggage from the terminal is an experience in itself. We waited an hour before our baggage arrived on the carousel and then it was a full on contact sport with the luggage carts to try to pull the suitcases off the conveyor belt. If you choose to fly with this airline, DO NOT book international flights on the same day. Overnight in Male and fly out the next day. It will save you a tremendous amount of stress. Or find an alternative to this airline.
reviews.author: AK_WorldTravelers

reviews.title: Horrific Customer Service and Significant Delays
reviews.text: Worst customer service I have ever experienced! Flight was supposed to leave at 6:10 but upon arrival was told was delayed until 6:50. Ok, no problem. Then 6:50 came and went and as the time started ticking over to 7:30, only then were we given any sort of explanation by the airline staff present, apologising for the delay and saying that the new departure time was now 9:30!!! Horrific communication and only when asked directly did they bother to give any sort of excuse. For a national airline, Maldivian is a sorry excuse.
reviews.author: Smithson

reviews.title: BAD SERVICE
reviews.text: the flight is very smelly , small and not confortable at all , we make more than 2 hours delay waiting in kooddodo airport without even appology from them
reviews.author: NAJLA Ep Hendawy

reviews.title: Ok for short trip
reviews.text: Flew on the dash 8 which sounded a bit like a lawn mower and my wife didn’t like but it does the job for what it’s intended to do . Short flights between islands.
reviews.author: Andy G

reviews.title: Comfortable inter island flight service
reviews.text: As part of a 6 flight & 3 week vacation we took the Malvivian Airways flight from the Kooddoo Airport which was the nearest to the Park Hyatt Resort, back to Male Airport. 10 days prior we took this carrier from Male to Kadhdhoo Airport & then to the the Kooddoo Airport. Their Dash 8 fleet are in great condition & the flight was seamless.
reviews.author: RichardWCT

reviews.title: Excellent island hopping service
reviews.text: As part of a 6 flights 3 week vacation we took the Maldivian airways flight Q2 274 from Male to Kadhdhoo Island & then on to Kooddoo Island. The Dash 8 twin propeller aircraft was full, however the flight was smooth & quiet. As our destination was at the southern tip of the atoll achipelago then it was too far for the seaplane service that we took in 2018. We noted that a prayer announcement was played over the PA before we took off ..... obviously it worked well as our flight was safe & uneventful.
reviews.author: RichardWCT

reviews.title: Not Great
reviews.text: As going to Kaadedhdhoo Island security was a nightmare too forever checking everything down to medicine you needed to travel When you get on the plane people are sitting in other peoples seats etc Not a great experience
reviews.author: Graham H

reviews.title: Not A Fun Experience
reviews.text: Flight did it's job but was hell Domestic Security was a nightmare Boarding was a lottery Just a horrible experience after 2 other international flights
reviews.author: Graham H

reviews.title: My first seaplane experience
reviews.text: This was my first seaplane flight experience. We headed to Baa Atoll and Anantara Kihavah resort for short vacations. The personnel from the resort met as at the Male International Airport and helped us along the way. Then we arrived to the lounge waiting for our seaplane take off. There were refreshments and food to make our wait more comfortable. Everyone were fully professional and assisted us with everything we needed. The flight was perfect with a breathtaking view of the atolls and o unique experience with a seaplane. The plane was nice, a bit was due to the humidity but it was ok. Overall was a pleasant and unique experience that i would wanted to live again.
reviews.author: Christos Papachristos

reviews.title: You get some amazing views ! Lovely flight
reviews.text: It was a short flight, less than 1 hour, but if you fly late afternoon you have a great view of the atolls ( islands) and its just beautiful. My flight was during Ramadan, I really appreciated that a neatly packed box for Iftar was handed out- that was very throughout! I am sure I will chose this airline again. One more thing - I had lots of extra luggage- it didn't cost a lot for the extra weight! so that was nice too.
reviews.author: 310dori

reviews.title: Refund Amount
reviews.text: I need to lodge a complaint to Authorities in Maldives or maybe there is any other means of complaining about Capital travel , as they need to pay me back a refund of around 10,000 INR, for a booking we did with them, it is almost 3 months, they have not yet refund the amount and there is no response now.
reviews.author: Mahalakshmi

reviews.title: Not too bad for domestic carrier
reviews.text: Flew return Male to Gan to our resort. On landing from our flight from Singapore we were met presumably by resort staff who accompanied us to the airport lounge and also escorted us to our flight onwards. This was a nice unexpected surprise. The lounge was spacious and comfortable with food provided. Its like a business lounge. The plane was a propeller Dash 8-300 with 2:2 seating arrangement. A light refreshment was provided. You also get a certificate for flying over the equator! Otherwise an uneventful flight both ways.
reviews.author: BunburyTim61

reviews.title: An average but necessary experience
reviews.text: This is, to my knowledge, the only major domestic airline in the Maldives which is Government run and effectively has a monopoly over a range of routes. The service is average but there is little choice but to use them depending on the resort you choose. Maldivian is prone to cancelling flights and sending you emails that are incorrect about flight changes/cancellations and timing. This does not create a relaxing experience. In the air everything seemed fine. Service is basic but okay, the boarding experience was ordinary and the baggage service quite good. The resort staff will assist with your dealings with Maldivian Airlines.
reviews.author: Peter T

reviews.title: Good flight
reviews.text: Took the internal flight from Male to Kaadeddhoo. After flying into Male on BA from London we were taken to the domestic departure lounge. Eventually making our way to the departure gate, we were about to board when I was asked to return to the checking for a security check on my luggage. After clearing this check it was back out to the aircraft. The plane was a Dash 8 and it was full with 48 passengers.The flight down south was lovely, great views over the atolls and we were even given a drink onboard. Flight was good on the outward and return leg.
reviews.author: Kevin K

reviews.title: Domestic flight effected by weather
reviews.text: I believe all the domestic airlines in Maldives has the small aircraft only. It was a little scary because our flight was effected by bad weather. It was almost about to land in GAN but there was no minimum vision available for landing. So pilot has announced that we are getting down to another airport which is about 20 minutes from GAN. Even it was scary and discomfort for all passengers, crew and pilots were really friendly and giving nice words to passengers . It must be appreciated because they are not responsible for the bad weather. Later once we lander in Kadhedo airport just about fifteen minutes our flight was ready to depart to GAN. it was really an amazing memory to remember that was our first domestic MALDIVIAN flight. :)
reviews.author: Shuhaib

reviews.title: Domestic flight travelling Experience
reviews.text: Maldivian air lines is only the flying all destinations in the Maldives Dharavandoo & Ifuru. They also fly to selected international destination in Asia region. Since no other airline flying to most of the domestic airports, There is no competition in terms of price and service quality. Therefore Maldivian is controlling the price fare and they don't seems to give any effort on improving the service. Taking Maldivian would be the only choice left for guest who are arriving at night for a resort or an island that does not have speed boat transfer available due to long distance. Flight was delayed 30 minutes. They given only Water cup for the Travellers. I see they have lots of thing to improve in order to give a better service
reviews.author: NR

reviews.title: THIS AIRLINE WILL LEAVE YOU STRANDED. DO NOT FLY! you were warned.
reviews.text: For context only, I’ve been to more than 60 countries and on seven continents. I have extensive travel experience in all regions of the world and Maldivian Airlines is by far the absolute worst. The most rude and unhelpful staff in the history of air travel, and probably the history of customer service. If their flights are delayed or cancelled to Male (as I was told by my hotel staff that they often are) the main international airport, and you miss a connection, as per their company policy - and I am putting this in all caps to point out what they say their policy is though it is published nowhere - THEY WILL NOT RE-BOOK YOU OR FIND ALTERNATIVE FLIGHTS FOR YOU. THEY WILL LEAVE YOU STRANDED IN MALE, forced to rebook international flights at premium prices last minute. My flight was to NYC via Rome. The Maldivian flight was delayed six hours in Gan because of a technical problem on their aircraft. I missed the flight to Rome, despite telling them about it in advance AS THEY ALSO REQUIRE. Ground staff in Gan had no information and would lie to your face that the crew in Male was working on a solution regarding connections. When arriving in Male, they had no solution. Luckily I rebooked myself on a Turkish Airlines flight and didn’t trust a word these liars said. They are liars. They have no integrity. A family with small children was in a similar situation and they were absolutely heartless. The staff “will take no responsibility” to get you home and will ignore you, walk away from you. They are untrained and a sorry excuse for a national carrier. This is an unbelievable lack of integrity and honesty in a place that is supposedly catering to international tourism. I feel sorry for anyone who chooses to fly for, or work for Maldivian. They are fraudulent. Will be pursuing remedies through credit card insurance and lawyers. They will not help you and will leave you to fend for yourself, which is hard when most cell phones do not work in the Maldives unless you have a national carrier, and WiFi is spotty and best in their small and dated airports. Beware of this airline. You were warned.
reviews.author: Oliver Von

reviews.title: our first trial with this airline
reviews.text: the staff are all so nice and helpful, the aircraft is very comfortable as well. we have a very good experience onboard.
reviews.author: Michelle Keey

reviews.title: No Choice
reviews.text: You will be lucky if for once the flight takes off on schedule. I have been flying this airline for the last five years and its often delayed or cancelled, the most unreliable airline I have experienced in my life. on board there's nothing much you can expect, for a $400 flight for an hour you will only get a cup of juice. There's no in flight entertainment and the aircraft is extremely old that it should be decommissioned. However there is no other choice if you want to travel between distant islands in the Maldives.
reviews.author: KevMW309

reviews.title: A hot oven for a short journey
reviews.text: Maldivian, the national carrier of Maldives operates flights to 11 airports out of the 12 airports in Maldives. The usual 6 hrs ride by speed launch or 14 hrs by boat in the rough seas are shortened to 45 minutes by the flight from Male' to kadhoo. But the hot oven feel like journey is not acceptable, pls do something about it and we will stop complaining about the small seats and that only juice was served as refreshment
reviews.author: fareeem

reviews.title: Reasonable domestic flight but please turn up the air con
reviews.text: We took an afternoon flight from MAL to KDM, get to wait at a lounge that provide a bit of snacks until boarding. It's a fleet with 50 passengers, corridor in the middle with 2 passengers on each side. During our afternoon flight, the view from the window is gorgeous. The air conditioning was also cooling. The 1 hour flight is pleasantly comfortable. It's only on our flight back from KDM to MAL, we got to wait at a mosquitoes area for 15 mins, waiting area is rather small. Then on our flight back, there is literally no air conditioning. You can see passengers fanning themselves trying to stay cool. Did the pilot forget to switch it on?
reviews.author: h2omelonlau

reviews.title: Comfortable way for domestic travel
reviews.text: It was only short domestic flight. The service staff was friendly, also the knowledge of English was quite bad, but they tried to help as they could. Check in and boarding were OK, the service was friendly also there. Of course on a short domestic flight, you can't expect the comfort of a long distance flight, but it was OK. Their aircrafts were very small. They have strict baggage restrictions.
reviews.author: romanshorner

reviews.title: Maldivian Airlines
reviews.text: We enjoyed our flight from Male to Kooddoo Airport by Maladivian Airlines. This is one of the best service provider in the region with on time departure and good connections. The staff on ground and on air were equally good. Our overall experience was good.
reviews.author: Harish B

reviews.title: Cancelled flight
reviews.text: Maldivian Airlines cancelled my flight to Male and put me on their next scheduled flight to Male meaning I missed my connecting flights with Qatar Airlines to Doha-Johannesburg-Durban and had to repurchase the entire leg! This despite informing Maldivian the times of my connecting international flight. I have since tried to recover costs of repurchasing return leg unsuccessfully although no fault of mine!
reviews.author: Trent B

reviews.title: Discrimination airline avoid DISGUSTING!
reviews.text: Obnoxious discrimination of race and color!! I am an asian live in the U.S. Me and my mom arrived the airport checking in before everyone else. However, all the front row seats were given to white passengers. Very unbelievable last minute before boarding the plane the receptionist came up to us to change our pass to back rows given reasons that the plane will be out of balance. I did not know how she gave our seats to other white passengers. Shame on you!! Avoid this discrimination airline FOREVER!!!
reviews.author: Jessica

reviews.title: Domestic Airline acceptable service
reviews.text: Maldivian Air is a local airline. If you visit the islands you arrive at Male int. you need either a transfer by speed boat, or plane to your island. We use Maldivian for our flights to Amari Havodaa island/hotel. The plane are mostly turbo props with a seating 2:2. we have a acceptable leg room. The plane are not new but they use the "working horses" which give you secure. The pilots can handle the specific condition when it comes to touch down (over water). So dont worry to fly with Maldivian. Looking forward to arrive your island. The crew is friendly and you get drinks and cold towels for the flight.
reviews.author: stephankern

reviews.title: Exactly what I would expect
reviews.text: Our flights with Maldivian were pretty good. The staff were impeccably presented, very professional. We received towelettes which was refreshing given the heat, juice was also given which was nice. Our flights ran on time, overall it was exactly what I would expect.
reviews.author: LouiseFatt

reviews.title: Good experience
reviews.text: Schedule was delayed by 3 hour and no reason was mentioned...hostess were good on practice : would recommend
reviews.author: Tony H

reviews.title: Awerage regional airline, but they get you were you want
reviews.text: This airline is neither good or bad, it is very awarege for being a regional airline. On Maldives, you do not have a option to choose as Maldivian is the only one. We flew Male-Kooddoo-Male. First flight the Dash8-300 tvin propeller plane felt quite old and heavily used. On the return flight it was a newer Dash8. Please observe that Carry on luggage is only 5 kg and only smaller bags then normal is allowed. This might cause you problem if you are connecting from a international Businessclas trip that allowed you heavier/bigger carry on. Same goes with your check in bag. They weigh everything, so if you must leave your Carry on to check in, you might find that you are above weight when its added and forced to pay extra. My recommendation is to only have 5kg for carry on and 15 kg check in.
reviews.author: Jonas H

reviews.title: No fixed schedule, no AC, stuffy
reviews.text: The worst 1 hour flight of my life. The flight has no fixed timing for take off I guess. We were mentally prepared to wait at Male airport for 3 to to 4 hours for the next scheduled flight to Kooddoo for our stay at the Residence Maldives. But we were told that this flight that was to take off much earlier is still there. So, we didn't have to wait at Male. Aircraft looked quite ok from the outside. Once seated we realised either there's no AC or it doesn't work. We were sweating, feeling suffocated and waiting desperately for the 1 hour to end. The very thought of taking the same flight on our return gave me nightmares even during our stay at the resort.
reviews.author: rastha2001

reviews.title: Small but efficient
reviews.text: This was my first time in the Maldives hence the first time taking a domestic flight to Kooddoo. The plane is small but the crew professional and efficient, it is a brief flight so the time goes by extremely fast. The flight was arranged by the resort Mercure Kooddoo so not sure if there are any additional options for other airlines. All an all I would fly again because i plan on visiting in the future
reviews.author: OverjoyedK

reviews.title: Flying was simple.
reviews.text: We flew to Chennai on 26th March by Maldivian Airline and had a relaxing journey. Nothing special, a basic service with very "simple" food. Just a croissant sandwich and a cup of juice. Cabin crews were pleasant and helpful. We returned to Male' today. Good clean flight with nice crew set. Meal was good, chicken curry with rice and salad, bread, butter and nice dessert with tea coffee and juice were provided. Captain Sultan communicated well from the cockpit. Dhivehi mathindhaa boatakun dhivehi falhuverin thakakaa eku dhathurukuraairu dhivehi bahun kihineh tho ahaalaa dhivehinnah kudakoh samaalukameh dheveynama miah vureves furihama vees. Mi flight ga Fathimath **mna kiyaa varah reethi kujjaku huri. Shukuriyya ey buneleema balaaves nuli. Varah Salaam. Mikudhinah eba visnaidhee angaa dheyn eba jehey thimannanenge musaara kolhu hamajassa miAirline mi hinganee miboat faharun dhathuru kuraa dhon meehun ge ithurun gina bangaalheennaai India meehun adhi Dhivehin paykuraa laari jamaakohgen kan. Ehen veema dhon Kalhu nubalaa gaiga dhuvaa vahakah moonu anburaanulaa thimannamen kiyevi customer care lesson aa ehgothah khidhumah foarukoh dheyn eba jehey. Eirun dhathuru kuraa fathuru verin ginave mi Airline ge viyafaari fulhaave vazeefaa demi onnaanee. Kuriyah dhivehi Qawm.
reviews.author: Life is a journey
